This site has no contact form and sets no cookies. Nothing you send is shared with third parties.

Before you write

  • SeaBrick is a research programme. There are no bricks for sale and no investment offering.
  • Design files for the brick's connection features are not distributed. The 3D models on this site are smoothed visualization models for that reason.
  • If you are a student or researcher, say which problem interests you: materials, joints, waves, life-cycle assessment or manufacturing.

SeaBrick Society is a not-for-profit corporation incorporated in Canada in 2022 to promote innovation and standards around environmentally sustainable marine infrastructure building materials.

Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada
